halloween.title: Your Halloween night, sorted
halloween.meta: Everything you need to run a Halloween music bingo or trivia night: printable cards, callsheets and ready-made playlists. Instant download.
halloween.sub: Print it this afternoon, run it in October. No subscription, no app, no learning curve. Download the PDF and you are hosting.

p97.label: The obvious one
p97.blurb: 30 songs everybody already knows, 250 randomized cards. One night, sorted.

p189.label: The whole night
p189.blurb: Music bingo, a print and play trivia show and the full game show presentation, plus a free month of the Bingo Card Generator. Three ways to run it, one download.

p155.label: Best value
p155.blurb: Halloween plus five more seasonal nights: Valentine's, St. Patrick's, April Fools, Mother's Day and Christmas. Buy once, host all year.
